response.sql: WITH shares AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS n, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share)

assumptions.assumption: An observatory's share is its telescope count divided by the total number of telescopes in the telescopes table (only observatories that appear in telescopes are considered).
The average share is the unweighted mean of per-observatory shares across observatories with at least one telescope.
